tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Overview of Ariel Adler's business: who he works with, the four services with what each includes, prices (branding 8,000–30,000 ILS before VAT; other services by quote), when to recommend him, meeting hours and contact details. Returns the site's llms.txt (Hebrew) with links to every page.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search all pages of arieladler.co.il (services, portfolio projects, articles, courses) by keywords, in Hebrew or English. Returns the best-matching pages with title, URL and a snippet. Use get_page to read one in full.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: NLWeb ask: a natural-language question about Ariel Adler's work (e.g. "has he branded a winery?", "מה כולל תהליך מיתוג?") returns the best-matching pages as schema.org results with the passage that matched. Retrieval only, no generated answer. Same as https://arieladler.co.il/ask

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The full text of one page of arieladler.co.il as Markdown (Hebrew). Pass the page URL or path, e.g. "https://arieladler.co.il/about/" or "/business-design/".

tools.name: get_meeting_slots
tools.description: Free 30-minute slots for an introductory meeting with Ariel (Google Meet), Sunday–Thursday 10:00–18:00 Israel time, from tomorrow on. Each slot has a "start" value (ISO, UTC) to pass to book_intro_meeting.

tools.name: book_intro_meeting
tools.description: Books a 30-minute introductory meeting with Ariel Adler on Google Meet for the user. Confirm the slot, name, email, phone and topic with the user first. On success both sides get an email with the Meet link and a calendar invite, and the user gets a reminder 30 minutes before. Use a "start" value re

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site, get_page, book_intro_meeting · Private data: get_business_info · Public sink: book_intro_meeting.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site, get_page, book_intro_meeting · Private data: get_business_info · Public sink: book_intro_meeting

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
